title: Find a Home for Your Property

context_sources.name: National Bureau of Statistics of China

limitations: A MATHmodels watermark of repeated glyphs runs through every page and through the equations.
Equations 1 to 26 print with sums and indices separated by placeholder blocks.
The contents page scrambles the section order, listing sections 6 and 7 before section 5.
Table 1, the risk checklist, does not survive in the text layer.
The summary's scenario count and interest range disagree with the body.

tasks: Decide whether an insurer should underwrite each of two regions on different continents
Decide where and whether to build inside one region, and with what materials
Score buildings for protection and assign measures by level
Apply both models to one landmark that has faced extreme weather

section_map.summary: Two probabilities, a building cutoff, four protection bands, and one landmark score.
A named official quoted, then a 7-fold rise and a 30 to 60 percent forecast.
Four tasks, each answered in the next line.
Four assumptions, each with its own justification.
A short table, the rest deferred.
Risk, price, a three-way split of the premium, and a sign test.
Guangdong accepted, Florida refused, profit from a base rate of 0.0034.
Distance-scaled risk plus convenience, searched by particle swarm.
Entropy weights and TOPSIS, binned into four levels with measures.
The Forbidden City at 61 percent and a score of 0.618.
The decision survives the rate test; the score moves by at most 5 percent.
Four strengths, three weaknesses, the data limit stated.
Three time horizons and a cost of 60 percent of profit.

contributions.summary: Policy risk is split by controllability, and the part nobody can change is weighted higher.
Premium income is divided into reserve, reinsurance, and investment before profit is computed.
The regional risk is rescaled by a fitted function of distance, so the same model sites a building.
The protection score is binned, and each bin is given measures whose cost matches the bin.

dependency_graph.handoff: The regional external risk is rescaled by distance to site the building.
The underwriting frequency and the protection score are both reported for the same landmark.

assumptions.summary: Demand for policies is known and does not move with the rate.
The probability of a payout rises with the policy risk.
Every building in a region shares one external risk.
An insurer can pass risk on by buying reinsurance.
Convenience falls linearly inside 2 km and disappears beyond it.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: NOAA's 28 billion-dollar disasters of 2023, eight of them hitting Florida.
Six typhoons and 25 days of heavy rain in Guangdong in 2022, with losses above half a billion dollars.
Insured amounts drawn from a normal distribution around the mean property value, with spread at a fifth of the mean.
The July 2023 Beijing rainstorm, first reported at 166 million RMB.
Landmark data for the Forbidden City, the Mogao Caves, and the Canton Tower, popularity from a search index.

models.summary: Decides underwriting from the sign of simulated profit.
Sites a building by safety and convenience inside a rectangle.
Scores a building and bins it into a protection level.

verification.summary: The distance curve is fit with a residual sum of squares of 0.008.
Raising the investment return from 2 to 7 percent leaves both underwriting decisions unchanged.
Moving one protection indicator changes the score by at most 5 percent.

results_trace.summary: Guangdong is profitable in 63 percent of scenarios and is underwritten; Florida in 26 percent and is refused.
The insurer turns profitable at a base rate near 0.0034.
The best site shown is at (1.2, 0.4), and sites below 0.5 satisfaction are rejected.
The Forbidden City is profitable in 61 percent of scenarios.
Protection scores are 0.618, 0.364, and 0.215 for the Forbidden City, the Mogao Caves, and the Canton Tower.

writing_logic.summary: Name both parties who lose before naming any model.
Quote a named official, then attach one multiplier and one forecast band.
Restate each task and answer it in the next line.
Give every assumption its own justification.
Explain a result by the speed of two increases, then hand the other party a lever.
Concede the economic objection before setting it aside.
Close the letter on the landmark enduring, not on the budget.

language_observations.summary: The insurer is called an economic being, so the profit rule reads as character rather than formula.
A weight is defended with one country's building practice.
Each method is defined in a sentence before it is used.
The weaknesses name the missing data rather than a vague limitation.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1 maps abnormal temperatures and credits the Copernicus service.
Figure 2 draws the whole argument as one flowchart.
Figure 3 sets Florida against Guangdong, each as a cloud of scenarios.
Figure 4 shows profit turning positive as the base rate rises.
Figure 5 plots the fitted function of distance.
Figure 6 colors satisfaction from red to green over the region.
Figure 7 lays out four indicators and eight sub-indicators.
Figure 8 shows the entropy weight of each indicator.
Figure 9 draws the four protection bands on the score.
Figure 10 lists the measures that belong to each band.
Figure 11 repeats the scenario plot for the Forbidden City.
Figures 12 and 13 show the two sensitivity tests.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge rewards a decision rule that is a single, checkable sign.
A judge rewards a model reused for a second task by changing exactly one factor.
A judge notices when the summary and the body quote different ranges for the same test.

weaknesses.summary: The payout probability is the risk divided by ten, tuned by debugging.
The number of scenarios is given as 100, 1000, and 100 depending on the page.
The interest range is 0.002 to 0.007 in the summary and 2 to 7 percent in the body.
The prose credits Beijing with the score computed for the Forbidden City.
The weights rest entirely on Chinese landmarks.

independent_extensions.statement: Replace the payout probability of risk over ten with one estimated from claims data.
independent_extensions.reason: The paper says the divisor was found by debugging, so the decision rests on an untested constant.

independent_extensions.statement: Recompute the entropy weights with landmarks from outside China and check whether the bands hold.
independent_extensions.reason: The paper itself flags the geographic limit of its data.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Supports rescaling a regional risk by a fitted function of distance.
Supports an underwriting rule defined as the sign of profit after a three-way use of the premium.

unresolved_questions: Which scenario count, 100 or 1000, the decisions actually rest on.
Whether the interest test varied the rate by tenths of a percent or by several percent.
What risk threshold separates the policies that get reinsured.
